agenda_text:
CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, September 17, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst

  2. PRESENTATIONS – None

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – August 20, 2025

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program – Armando Cisneros
  b. Meals on Wheels Program – Armando Cisneros
  c. Bingo Report – George Borst
  d. Account Balance Update – Armando Cisneros
  e. Monthly Senior Program Fees – Armando Cisneros
  f. Mt. SAC Classes Update – Armando Cisneros
  g. Aging Next – Armando Cisneros
  h. Outstanding Older American – Armando Cisneros
  i. Facilities Report – Yvonne Duran
  j. Upcoming Events – Robyn Olsen
   5. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 a.m. on October 15, 2025 at the La Verne Community Center, 3680 D Street, La
  Verne CA 91750.

Posting Statement: On September 10, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted
on the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website
at www.laverneca.gov.
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, September 17, 2025

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, September 17, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Jenny Jolly, Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: None.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist. Yvonne Duran, Parks & Recreation
  Director.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, August 20, 2025 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 630 meals were served to an average of 30 participants in
  August.

  Meals on Wheels: NA.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo receipts totaled $6,810.00. Ending balance in the
  account through August was $0 after $6,810.00 in payouts and expenses.
  The number of players in attendance for the month of August: 213.

5. Account Balance: $3,222.43.

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Fall Session is going well.

8. Outstanding Older American: Applications will be going out and the final vote will
  be taken during the first meeting in January 2026.
 9. Aging Next: Total number of La Verne Residents served for the month of
  August was 13. La Verne Residents served via Joslyn Center: 4. La Verne
  Residents served via AgingNext Office: 9.

  New Business

10. Facilities Report: Yvonne reported that the AC unit in the Dance Studio is
  being replaced. The leak in the Senior Craft room will be repaired. Veterans
  Hall is in good condition.

11. Upcoming Events

  •  Friday, September 19th – Senior Seminar: Your Cold & Flu Season Survival Guide, Presented by
  Embrace Health, 10:30AM.
  •  Saturday, September 20th – Excursion: Solvang Danish Days, 8:00AM-7:00PM.
  •  Tuesday, September 23rd – Health & Resource Fair and Flu-Shot Clinic, 9:00AM-11:30AM.
  •  Wednesday, September 24th – Senior Seminar: Fall Prevention, Presented by Independence at Home,
  10:30AM.
  •  Sunday, October 5th – Excursion: Big Bear Lake Oktoberfest, 9:30AM-6:00PM.
  •  Wednesday, October 8th – Senior Seminar: Cyber Security (Fraud Prevention), Presented by the
  YWCA, 10:30AM.
  •  Friday, October 10th – Senior Seminar: Dealing with Arthritis, Presented by Independence at Home,
  10:30AM.
  •  Saturday, October 11th – Trunk or Treat, 5:00PM-8:00PM.
  •  Monday, October 13th – Movie Matinee: Coco, 12:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, October 15th – Senior Seminar: Pumpkin Spice & Medicare Advice, Presented by
  Embrace Health Insurance.

  Public Comments: Scott announced a Craft Fair will be held at Hillcrest on
  October 11, 2025 from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. The store will also offer discounts.
  The Gallery at Hillcrest is presenting “Vision in Nature” featuring two artists;
  Sherie Garner and Ruth Ellyn Whittington through the month of September.
  New artists will be featured after September. Bette Donovan mentioned that to
  add Bunco to the center’s activities it would need volunteers. Yvonne said they
  can mention the request in the Senior Newsletter. Guest Leo asked if there
  could be a group of seniors or anyone willing to monitor the school’s
  entryways due to the school shootings. This is a matter for the school board
  and Bonita School District and should be taken up with them. Yvonne stated
  we have a new Senior Advisory Committee member, Valerie Ortiz. Current
  member’s appointments expire in 2027 & 2028. Yvonne stated the new Parks
  and Recreation Commission will have its first meeting in January. They will
  meet 4 times per year. AARP will offer refresher driver courses in October.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:45AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, October 15, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
